name: proto-ts-generators
description: Pinned non-protobuf-es TypeScript generators bundled into the codefly proto companion image. protoc-gen-es is pinned separately (built from source in flake.nix, npm-installed in the Dockerfile) and guarded by companion_plugins_test.go; these two are kept in lockstep with the Dockerfile's npm install -g list by ts_generators_pin_test.go so the Nix and Docker images ship identical toolchains.
